dedupe_keys.name: cartographie du reseau grdf en service

description: Cartographie du réseau GRDF en service is a dataset listed in GRDF open data portal, an open data portal of a gas distribution operator, published or maintained by GRDF. Ce jeu de données linéaires comporte l’ensemble des canalisations en service du réseau de distribution de gaz exploité par GRDF disponible à date. Les informations du tracé du réseau communiquées par GRDF sont fournies à titre indicatif. Coverage: France. It carries geographic features and can be exported as GeoJSON, KML or Shapefile. The portal files it under Cartographie des réseaux. Its keywords are Infrastructure, réseau. The portal shows 2025-03-24 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is Licence Ouverte (Etalab) (https://www.etalab.gouv.fr/wp-content/uploads/2014/05/Licence_Ouverte.pdf). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support network planning and operations studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-grdf-open-data-portal.
